notes.XDspActivate: type 1 convolution (XDefiant) on host; types 2 and 3 return E_NOTIMPL, no title uses them

notes.D3D12XboxCreateDevice: Xbox One params (0x28 bytes) checked for null, then handed to the emulator's d3d12_xs.dll (Scarlett vtable wrapper, PC slots 0-43 only verified for Xbox One); host D3D12CreateDevice if d3d12_xs is absent
notes.D3D12XboxSetProcessDebugFlags: stores flags & 0x81f00001 like the console runtime
notes.D3D12XboxUnloadDriverModule: S_OK; no xgs12 user-mode driver on PC
notes.D3DMapEsramMemory: flags 1/3 only (else E_FAIL, as console); one 32 MiB ESRAM section, each page-list entry maps that 64 KiB ESRAM page at VA+i*64K, so pages alias across VAs and keep contents across remaps; a caller reservation around the range is kept

notes.DxcCreateInstance: official DXC 1.9.2609 (Microsoft-signed dxcompiler.dll + dxil.dll): next to dxcompiler_x, TOMBOX_DXC_DIR, or emulator third_party/dxc; compiles SM 6.0 HLSL to signed DXIL

notes.XApuConnect: processType 2 (Opus) on host; types 1 and 3 return E_NOTIMPL, no title uses them
notes.XApuDisconnect: waits for in-flight host decodes, then frees
notes.XApuEnqueueCommand: async like the console submit ring: commands go to a host worker pool, per-stream order kept
notes.XApuDequeueResult: results commit in submission order, result event signalled on commit

notes.XFrontPanelGetButtonStates: emulated panel buttons (F1-F5 = buttons 1-5, arrows, Enter = select while the panel window has focus)
notes.XFrontPanelGetLightStates: returns the 5 light bits last set
notes.XFrontPanelPresentBuffer: console validation (size 0x4000 else E_INVALIDARG, null E_POINTER); frame kept and drawn in a 768x192 panel window (TOMBOX_FRONTPANEL=0 hides it)
notes.XFrontPanelSetDisplayName: E_INVALIDARG on null as on console; name logged and shown in the panel window title
notes.XFrontPanelSetLightStates: keeps lights & 0x1f, drawn under the panel, changes logged

notes.XGComputeOptimalDepthStencilTileModes: console rules: MSAA 2/4 -> 1, 8 -> 2, TC-compatible -> 7, HTILE -> 4, stencil formats refuse compressed modes (oracle-verified)
notes.XGComputeOptimalTileMode: GCN selection (buffer 31, 1D 8, 2D 13/14, +3 for 64KB swizzle, 3D 13/14, depth path), verified against console xg_x for 100k+ inputs
notes.XGComputeTexture2DLayout: GCN layout model, byte-identical to console XG_RESOURCE_LAYOUT for modes 8/13/14/31
notes.XGCreateTexture2DComputer: layouts byte-identical to console; 1D-thin and linear texel addressing identical; 2D-thin addressing self-consistent (bank/pipe swizzle not yet modelled)
notes.XGCreateTextureComputerWithPitch: pitch argument logged, computed pitch used
notes.XGSetHardwareVersion: revision flag = version >= 2 (signed), feeds depth/stencil validation
notes.XGValidateDepthStencilTileMode: console compatibility table for both hardware revisions (oracle-verified)
notes.XGValidateJpegFile: console marker parser: baseline 8-bit 3-component, 4:2:0 -> NV12, 4:2:2 -> YUY2, 8192 limit, APP byte count (oracle-verified)
